Name: TREx Automated Tag Extraction
Description:
TREx is a software solution, automating the collection of tagging information from engineering documents in PDF.

TREx ensures high quality, accurate and complete data, automatically generated at a fraction of the cost.

What is TREx used for?

Handover/Turnover documentation dossiers: 
Handover dossiers for Client/operators showing which engineering deliverable is referenced in which document. Providing this information is almost always a contractual obligation.

Document Searches:
TREx facilitates instant identification of tagged equipment references in drawings and documents throughout in the engineering, construction and operation phases, allowing engineers and construction staff to find all the documents relevant to their system quickly instead of wasting time trawling through files.

Reporting and Forecasting:
Using tagging information to support reporting, forecasting for projects as well as providing quality data to all of those that need it most.

The Benefits of TREx:
Accurate data, always up-to-date at the touch of a button and at a fraction of the time and cost spent without the software. 

The value of TREx:
Engineering Procurement and Construction Management companies now have to comply with data standards as many of their clients are now implementing digital project delivery. Capital Facilities Information Handover Specification (CFIHOS) standard is intended to help with the following: 

• Get the right information needed to operate, maintain and decommission a facility safely 
• Distribute the information easily with other stakeholders and engineering maintenance systems 
• Find the information quickly when needed in context 

How TREx works: 

• One simple configuration setup 
• Point the tool at your company / project document base 
• Extract a list of compliant and non-compliant assets 
• Extract your project document to asset listing 
• Extract your project document to document cross reference listing

Beck Electric Actuators provide industry leading control capabilities in a robust maintenance free design, They are ideally suited for any application, but particularly those that have demanding operating cycles or are in harsh environments. 

Vamien butterfly valves are high quality engineered quarter turn valves for either on/off or flow control applications. They are suitable for a wide range of applications in heavy industry, energy, shipbuilding through to water and sewage treatment and the food industry.

Beck actuators and Vamein valves together provide the perfect flow control system for any industry.

Harmonic Reducers are highly compact, lightweight mechanical gear systems consisting of just three individual components.
Offering high reduction ratios of up to 160:1, zero backlash and high torque outputs, Our Harmonic Reducers offer a simple effective alternative to traditional gearmotors in demanding applications.
When coupled to a servo motor the harmonic reducer allows for precise positioning accuracy with excellent repeatability of machinery making them ideal for applications that need a high level of accurate control.

Our range of Airsweep flow control systems are designed to keep material flowing in bunkers, hoppers or conveyor chutes. 
The pulse of compressed air from the AirSweep nozzles directs a high-pressure/high-volume, 360-degree burst between the material and vessel wall to lift and sweep even even the toughest materials eliminating bridging and build up and keeping the material flowing.

We supply spares, repairs,and new couplings, along with product support for most types of fluid coupling, including those that were supplied by Fluidrive, Vulcan Sinclair, Pembril.

Name: CFTS Ltd
Description:
CFTS is the national accreditation scheme for Thorough Examinations — a legal requirement to ensure that all critical parts of lifting equipment are in safe working order.  

Since 2004, CFTS has been helping companies across the UK comply with regulations governing both lifting and driving mechanisms under LOLER (Lifting Operations and Lifting Equipment Regulations) and PUWER (Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations). 

Our quality-controlled Thorough Examination procedure includes up to five times the number of checks compared to other inspection providers — saving employers time, money, and frustration. 

The CFTS mark is your guarantee that your truck will be examined carefully, with key components such as brakes and steering (PUWER) checked alongside the lifting mechanism (LOLER). Only CFTS-accredited companies and Competent Persons that have committed to adhering to the strict Quality Assurance Procedural Code are allowed to use this mark. 

There are currently more than 3,000 Competent Persons across the UK and Ireland who take pride in carrying out their work with total integrity and confidence in conducting a safe, fair, and legal Thorough Examination. 

Competent Persons must have the appropriate experience and training to carry out a Thorough Examination. They require at least five years’ experience servicing and maintaining lifting equipment and undergo regular training and strict checks to ensure their competence and independence.

Please see video link in updates or visit our web site to view at www.esidock.com

The Esidock unique design incorporates the fundamental principles for efficiency, safety and energy conservation whilst maintaining an unbroken seal between the docked vehicle and the loading dock.

This information tells you what temperatures your product reached, for how long and at what point of the process. Process engineers know what the perfect profile for their product should be and variations from the ideal indicate a potential problem or unacceptable quality. The systems run continuously on conveyor lines, collecting real-time data on product quality, dimensional compliance, line performance, and downtime — without interrupting production.

Inline quality control. No end-of-line inspection.

Downtime monitoring. Every line stoppage is recorded automatically — time, duration, and frequency. Data is available per shift and over time, making it straightforward to identify recurring causes and track whether interventions are working.

Production performance tracking. Live data on output per hour, shift totals, reject rates, and OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness). The dashboard gives plant managers and production supervisors an accurate picture of line performance without relying on manual counts or operator estimates.

Automated production reporting. Shift and daily reports are generated directly from production data — timestamped, accurate, and consistent across shifts. Replaces manual logs and removes variability in how performance is recorded.

Description:

Name: Universal Robots
Description:
Universal Robots is the global leader in collaborative robotics, enabling companies to automate faster, safety and with greater flexibility. 

With 100,000+ cobots deployed worldwide, Universal Robots has set the standard for user-friendly automation with our intuitive PolyScope software, award-winning training program, and the world's largest cobot ecosystem. Name: KEYENCE CORPORATION
Description:
KEYENCE is a worldwide leader in the development and manufacturing of factory automation equipment ranging from automation sensors, measuring instruments, vision systems, laser markers and digital microscopes. Our innovative products meet customer requirements in every manufacturing and research industry. 

In our fiscal year 2025, KEYENCE sales reached 7.3 billion US dollars while efficiently operating with around 12,000 employees in 46 countries across the world.  KEYENCE sales have grown at an average annual rate of over 10% for the past 25 years, has been ranked within the top 100 of Forbes’s list of “The World’s Most Innovative Companies” for 8 years in a row, and has been named one of Boston Consulting Group’s “Top 50 Value Creators” for 9 years in a row.

At KEYENCE, we pride ourselves on providing a wide variety of manufacturers the world's best automation technologies. KEYENCE notably offers a full range of services provided by technically trained sales engineers such as application problem solving, technical sales support, and a quick response time to any customer request.

Name: ifm
Description: First a passion, then an idea transformed into success – when it comes to pioneering automation and digitalisation technology, the ifm group is the ideal partner. Since its foundation in 1969, ifm has developed, produced and sold sensors, controllers, software and systems for industrial automation and for SAP-based solutions for supply chain management and shop floor integration worldwide. As one of the pioneers of Industry 4.0, ifm develops and implements consistent solutions to digitalise the entire value chain “from sensor to ERP”. Today, the second-generation family-run ifm group has more than 9,000 employees and is one of the worldwide market leaders. The group combines the internationality and innovative strength of a growing group of companies with the flexibility and close customer contact of a medium-sized company.

Name: Phoenix Contact
Description:
Phoenix Contact is an independent, global market leader with headquarters in Blomberg, Germany. More than 20,000 enthusiastic people around the world develop, produce, and sell our creative solutions in connection technology, electronics, and automation.

The "Phoenix terminals" and "Phoenix connectors" are known worldwide. We see our work as a contribution to designing a smart world. A global network in more than 100 countries guarantees the important proximity to our customers.

Our innovative products and solutions are characterized by high quality. Users in many industrial fields – electric-mobility, mechanical engineering, wind energy, solar energy, building automation, cyber security, automotive – trust Phoenix Contact products.

Name: FANUC Europe
Description:
FANUC Europe Corporation, headquartered in Echternach, Luxembourg, is the European branch of FANUC Corporation, a global leader in industrial automation. With over 1,500 employees across more than 25 countries, FANUC Europe offers CNC systems, industrial robots, and factory automation solutions tailored to industries such as automotive, aerospace, electronics, and healthcare.

Its key subsidiaries include FANUC Germany, FANUC France, FANUC UK, FANUC Italy, FANUC Iberia, FANUC Poland, FANUC Czech, FANUC Switzerland, FANUC Austria, FANUC Nordic, FANUC Romania, FANUC Adria, FANUC Bulgaria, FANUC Slovakia and FANUC Hungary, ensuring local service, support, and training.

Name: Comau
Description:
Comau is a worldwide leader in delivering advanced automation solutions. The company designs and develops products and systems that help customers improve productivity, flexibility, and competitiveness across a wide range of industries – all while keeping sustainable production at the forefront. Comau also offers project management, consultancy services and, through its Academy, innovative training. Together with fully owned companies Automha and Invent, Comau’s end-to-end automation and intralogistics capabilities span manufacturing, storage, distribution, and material flow optimization. Automha specializes in intelligent, high-performance automated storage and retrieval systems, while Invent provides advanced picking and sorting technologies, material handling systems, and warehouse control software. Together, these complementary capabilities help optimize logistics operations and enhance distribution performance.  
Comau is headquartered in Turin, Italy, Automha in Bergamo, Italy, and Invent in São Paulo, Brazil. The combined global footprint spans 9 innovation centers and 15 production facilities across 12 countries, supported by more than 4,000 employees worldwide.

Name: IMI Industrial Automation
Description:
We create solutions for our customers that enable smarter, safer, more productive, and sustainable factories, production lines, and warehouse operations. With four trusted product brands—IMI Norgren, IMI Bimba, IMI Bahr, and IMI Buschjost—we deliver a world-class portfolio of motion and fluid control solutions. Each brand brings unique expertise and technologies, ensuring you have access to the right solution for your needs.

For over a century, we have partnered with customers in Industrial Automation, applying our experience and innovation to create lasting value for their businesses. Our solutions support critical industries such as automotive, food and beverage, pharmaceuticals, and even the space industry, enabling the automation of precision manufacturing, product assembly, testing, and packaging.

Our pneumatic, electric motion, and fluid control systems help machine builders and end users around the world automate and optimise manufacturing and warehousing processes.

 - IMI Norgren specialises in precision pneumatic motion control, offering actuators, air preparation equipment, and valve islands to enhance safety, productivity, and uptime.
 - IMI Bimba delivers pneumatic, hydraulic, electric, and vacuum solutions, providing reliable, customisable platforms for diverse applications.
 - IMI Bahr designs modular positioning systems, including electric cylinders and linear axes, for high-precision and reliable performance.
 - IMI Buschjost provides solenoid and process valves for managing water, air, steam, and aggressive media with safety and reliability.

Name: Renishaw
Description:
Renishaw is one of the world's leading engineering and scientific technology companies, with expertise in precision measurement and healthcare. The company supplies products and services used in applications as diverse as jet engine and wind turbine manufacture, through to dentistry and brain surgery. It is also a world leader in the field of additive manufacturing (also referred to as 3D printing), where it designs and makes industrial machines which ‘print' parts from metal powder.

It is a global business, with over 5,000 employees located in the 36 countries where it has wholly owned subsidiary operations. The majority of R&D work takes place in the UK, with the largest manufacturing sites located in the UK, Ireland and India.

For the year ended June 2024 Renishaw recorded sales of £691.3 million of which 95% was due to exports. The company's largest markets are China, USA, Japan and Germany.

Renishaw is guided by its purpose: Transforming Tomorrow Together. This means working with its customers to make the products, create the materials, and develop the therapies that are going to be needed for the future.

Established in 2016, Hai Robotics has become a leader in innovating effective solutions with significant efficiency gains for automated warehouse operations and order-fulfilment through their HaiPick Systems.

Name: E80 Group
Description:
Our Group was created with the aim of strengthening its presence on the international market and promoting innovation for an increasingly sustainable growth.
Specialized in the development of automated and integrated intralogistics solutions for manufacturers and distributors of consumer goods operating in the beverage, food, tissue and other sectors, in 1992 the company anticipated the concept of Industry 4.0: the Smart Factory, sustainable, interconnected and safe. Our main systems include a wide range of laser guided vehicles, palletizing robots, robotic stretch wrappers, pallet inspection systems, robotic labelers, high-density automated warehouses, storage and picking solutions.
The entire logistics flow is centrally supervised by the SM.I.LE80 software platform (Smart Integrated Logistics), that ensures the efficient integration of the systems, guaranteeing the optimal management of all operations, from the entry of raw materials to storage and shipping.
As of today, we completed more than 450 integrated plants in various parts of the world and installed over 2.800 robotic systems, 9.000 LGVs/AGVs and more than 50 automated high-density warehouses. Every day, our systems manage products worth over handle more than €  1.5 billion worldwide.
Our Group, based in Viano, Italy, is present in Australia, Brazil, Chile, the United Arab Emirates, France, Germany, Japan, Mexico, Spain, Sweden, the United Kingdom, Poland, Russia, Thailand and the USA with the aim of being close to its customers.
To this end, it offers 24/7 remote and on-site consulting and after-sales services ensuring businesses the highest levels of digitalization, reliability and reduced margin of error. Our Group fundamental assets are the result of the expertise gained in more than 45 years of history and the sharing of hardware and software competences: enhancement of people, investments in R&D, in addition to a deep technological knowledge and an important adaptability to market needs.

Pilz is a global supplier of products, systems and services for automation technology. As a pioneer of safe automation, Pilz creates safety for human, machine and environment. Founded in 1948, today the family business with its head office in Ostfildern is represented worldwide with 2500 employees in 42 subsidiaries and branches.

The technology leader offers complete automation solutions for Safety and Industrial Security on the machine. These include sensor, control and drive technology – as well as systems for industrial communication, diagnostics and visualisation. As a trusted systems integrator with more than 50 years of experience, we deliver end-to-end services: designing, implementing, and maintaining fulfillment centers powered by mechatronics, robotics, and advanced software solutions.

Description: The Interroll Group is the world's leading provider of material handling solutions. The company was founded in 1959 and has been listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange since 1997. Interroll supplies system integrators and equipment manufacturers with a comprehensive range of platform-based products and services in the categories "Rollers" (conveyor rollers), "Drives" (motors and drives for conveyor systems), "Conveyors & Sorters" (conveyors & sorters) and "Pallet Handling" (pallet conveying and storage). Interroll solutions are used in express and postal services, e-commerce, airports, food & beverage, fashion, automotive and other industries. The company counts leading brands such as Amazon, Bosch, Coca-Cola, DHL, Nestlé, Procter & Gamble, Siemens, Walmart and Zalando among its users. Description:
The world expert in gas analysis, Servomex has established itself as the leading provider of reliable, accurate, and stable gas measurement solutions to industries across the globe.

Servomex analyses change, so our customers can make it happen. We help businesses worldwide achieve a new level of accuracy in their operations. Working across a variety of industries, including power generation, hydrocarbon processing, industrial gases, and UHP/semiconductors, we believe that together we can create a cleaner, healthier, and more productive world.

With more than 70 years of expertise and research, Servomex has innovated ground-breaking sensor technology that empowers our customers to achieve their objectives with utmost safety and efficiency.

This includes pioneering Paramagnetic sensing technology, and developing Calorimetry, Coulometric, FID, Gas Chromatography, Infrared, Gas Filter Correlation, Laser Moisture, Plasma, Thermal Conductivity, Tunable Diode Laser (TDL), and Zirconia technologies. Combining these technologies with our comprehensive applications knowledge, we deliver industry-changing gas analysis for process control, quality, safety, emissions, and combustion.

Name: CASS (Conformity Assessment for Safety-Related Systems)
Description:
CASS is an open and transparent methodology for assessing compliance to IEC 61508 and related standards.

At its heart, there are a number of tables (assessment templates) that can be used to map evidence of compliance (the assessee’s documentation) to the relevant clauses from IEC 61508 and record the assessor’s evaluation of that evidence. The methodology guides the assessor through the various evaluations to be performed. Each template lists a number of ‘targets of evaluation’ (TOEs) relevant to a particular type of assessment.

The assessment templates are free of charge and are available from the Downloads page. There are a number of supplementary documents that, together with the templates, form the methodology. It can be used in-house to prepare evidence of conformity supporting a Self-declaration, used by external auditors or even for Accredited Certification. 
Advantages of using CASS

The CASS methodology has been designed by industry for industry to demonstrate functional safety compliance. It offers the following advantages:

•	Open to all and free of charge
•	Transparency in the assessment method 
•	The methodology can be used to support a (self-) declaration of conformity
•	Can be used by certification bodies and is recognised by national accreditation bodies
•	Evidence can be prepared by the duty holder in advance of an external audit
•	Compatibility with industry guidance standards such as IEC 61511

Being able to demonstrate compliance with IEC 61508 (or related standard) is important to many organisations because it:

•	Is required by regulatory authorities for many plant owner/operators
•	Provides assurance to business stakeholders of operating companies managing high risks
•	Enables competitive advantage for equipment and service providers
•	Provides increased confidence in procurement of safety-related equipment and services

Name: IoT Technologies Ltd
Description:
IoT Technologies Ltd is a UK engineering company that designs, manufactures and operates a complete remote monitoring stack: circuit design, PCB assembly, firmware, the ZARC radio network and the cloud monitoring platforms that run on it. All of it is built in the UK, with no licensed third-party technology in the signal chain.

THE ZARC NETWORK
ZARC is a proprietary 433 MHz long-range radio network built around a single deliberate design decision: transmission is one-way, with no inbound radio-control path.

That one decision pays twice.

Because there is no inbound channel, the remote-takeover class of attack has nothing to attach to. The channel is not defended with encryption; it does not exist.

And because a node never has to listen for commands, its radio sleeps until the node has something to report. That is how battery-powered sensors achieve multi-year life in the field. Nodes wake on events and scheduled readings, transmit, and return to sleep.

SENSORS THAT RETROFIT
Sensors fit existing equipment without rewiring, mains power or SIM contracts. Every node reports its own health, so a node that falls silent raises an alert.

MONITORING PLATFORMS
Our platforms turn the data ZARC carries into live dashboards, alerts and records, with live UK deployments at national scale, including critical national infrastructure, and data held in the UK.

Description:
The MSF approach is mainly about solving production bottlenecks and getting the best result by using the best solution to ensure the best possible productivity in the production process.

MSF is open-minded to adapt to any workshop planning scenario and its innovative approach makes it very competitive in this area.

First of all, a customer is asked some questions to understand the production process issues and the factory’s intent. MSF works 2 to 4 weeks to make the best scenario for solving problems and to create a simulation demo to present to customer decision makers if the solution can solve production process problems. The scenario prepared is run as a demo and presented to the customer and after accepting the step forward, MSF starts to prepare design of integration.

Secondly, depending on the needs of the customer, MSF steps the implementation phase, which can take 1 month for integration and 2-6 months for MSF modules, depending on the Planning & Scheduling (2-3 months), Warehouse Management (2-3 months) options.

MSF then installs the hardware and software real implementation to start the Implementation Phase for the 90-day use MSF system daily. Before starting this period, all production KPI data is copied for comparation. During this period, MSF is in the contact with customer as much as possible for best integration and best resolution. If necessary, usage feedback or integration problems are resolved by the parties.

At the end of the 90-day implementation period, the customer can see what the difference is between the productivity starting point and the MSF solution. MSF does not need to invest extra in the factory environment, retrieves all the data with its hardware, is processed on the web cloud and displays it in real-time reports. Thus, decision makers can enlighten how to get real productivity figures that will be the best and affordable at a given time.

Name: Delta Motion
Description:
Delta Computer Systems, Inc. dba Delta Motion is a manufacturer of industrial automation products with a focus on high-performance hydraulic motion control.  Delta’s RMC Motion Controllers deliver high-performance, closed-loop position and pressure/force control, boosting productivity in a wide range of applications across the globe.  For nearly 40 years, Delta has been known for best-in-class products, continuous improvement, and responsive, knowledgeable support for both legacy and new products.

Delta’s RMC Motion Controllers handle systems with up to 50 axes. With built-in Ethernet and many supported industrial communications protocols, connectivity to nearly any PLC or HMI is possible. RMC Motion Controllers are highly configurable to meet the needs of virtually any system or application with a variety of I/O modules that support a broad range of transducers and actuators. RMCs are designed to optimize challenging applications with an analog resolution up to 18 bits for both inputs and outputs, and control loop times down to 125 μsec. The RMC200 Standard is for large applications with up to 50 axes of motion, and the RMC200 Lite handles up to 18 axes. The RMC150 supports up to 8 axes, and the RMC75 handles systems with 1 to 2 axes.


The RMC200, RMC150, and RMC75 are programed via the same powerful RMCTools software package. RMCTools is used for setting up, tuning, troubleshooting, programming, and controlling all features of Delta's motion controllers. RMCTools is a development environment, which allows for plotting, logging, and programming, providing an immediate overview and easy access to all aspects of your motion application. Connect RMCTools via USB, Ethernet, or RS-232 serial.  Supported operating systems include Windows 11/10/8.1/7.

Connect. Control. Optimize.

To learn more, view tutorials, or get a quote, visit deltamotion.com.

Name: Meditech Automation
Description:
The rapid integration of advanced technology into existing logistical infrastructure has accelerated the speed and efficiency of many distribution centres across the globe. The impact of which, is evident in every day life for many millions of people., with improved customer service, delivery times, and overall user experience. 

Hospitals themselves can be considered as logistical hubs within their own right, with large volumes of equipment and medication being delivered across many departments in a single day. According to a case study from 2009 detailing transportation tasks which take place in hospitals, “more than 850 man hours” are spent per week “on transfer of goods, linens, biological samples, medical equipment, pharmaceuticals, mail parcels and medical waste... in a 500 bed hospital” [1].  Most of which takes place by hand, using manually pushed carts by overworked health care staff. 

This therefore presents large commercial potential for automation, giving rise to improved working conditions, which translates into a more efficient caring environment for patients and staff, at significantly reduced costs. 

 At MediTech Automation, we are on a mission to improve the quality of life for many patients and healthcare staff alike, while providing a vigorous, advanced automated system, which can keep pace with the dynamic environments of busy hospitals around the world.

With the integration of our advanced Mark 1 technology platform, major cost savings can be implemented, alongside the enhanced traceability and security of items in transit. We aim to provide localised, tailored, and ingeniously delivered health care solutions to hospitals around the world. 

[1] A. G. Ozkil, Z. Fan, S. Dawids, H. Aanes, J. K. Kristensen, and K. H.
Christensen, “Service robots for hospitals: A case study of transportation tasks in a hospital,” in 2009 IEEE International Conference on Automation and Logistics, Aug 2009, pp. 289–294.
